title: MeshMend Archetype Root-Cause Debug Report
scope: Pre-sculpt silhouette and body-origin diagnostic. Sculpt/detail passes intentionally not run.

sources.high_elf_body_source: meshmend/studio/staged_pipeline.py:903-1023 _build_high_elf_category_mesh is a High Elf branch, but it still constructs anatomy/armor/glaive/cape from ellipsoid/cone/tapered_limb primitives, not authored sculpt assets.
sources.archetype_source: meshmend/studio/staged_pipeline.py:110-186 CharacterArchetypeGenerator only has a dedicated High Elf branch; Dwarf/Orc/Human Knight fall back to generic faction/role rules.
sources.shape_language_source: meshmend/studio/staged_pipeline.py:219-266 ShapeLanguageEngine only has a dedicated High Elf profile; other archetypes use generic required tags.
sources.armor_weapon_pose_source: Armor/weapons/pose are generated procedurally in _build_category_mesh/_build_high_elf_category_mesh; pose is mostly fixed part coordinates plus metadata tags, not an authored pose asset.
sources.silhouette_source: SilhouetteCritic/PreSculptRecognizabilityGate use metadata tags, bbox ratios, and projected thumbnail metrics; they are not a vision model and do not ask a human-recognizability question.
sources.legacy_native_path: 3dsculpter/model_service/native_generation.py and native_sculpt_backend.py also contain primitive ellipsoid/box/capsule-based humanoid builders; non-High-Elf prompts often fall back to armored_humanoid.

failure.reason: Mandatory four-archetype pre-sculpt test fails because Dwarf, Orc, and Human Knight do not have dedicated staged archetype geometry; they fall back to generic humanoid procedural modules. High Elf has a branch, but it is still primitive-built rather than authored anatomical/armor assets.

root_cause: The humanoid body originates in procedural primitive builders, not in a race-specific anatomical or armor asset library.

Cube/cylinder/capsule/ellipsoid primitives survive because they are the actual production part geometry. The code names them component-library parts, but the library is generated from primitives at runtime.

High Elf requests affect the concept profile, metadata tags, and some proportions, and route to _build_high_elf_category_mesh. They do not replace the body generator with authored High Elf sculpt assets.

Dwarf Warrior, Orc Brute, and Human Knight are not implemented as staged shape-language branches in CharacterArchetypeGenerator or ShapeLanguageEngine, so their silhouettes are generic humanoid layouts with different labels/details.
Silhouette validation is not a semantic vision critic. It uses tags, bbox ratios, and simple projected metrics, so it can pass a mesh whose silhouette is still mannequin-like to a human.
Faction-specific assets are mostly procedural branches and metadata tags, not curated faction/race asset libraries.
